content: .{@-संस्कारः, -संस्क्रिया@} [अङ्गं संस्क्रियते अनेन; कृ-करणे or भावे घञ्] .²1 embellishment of person, personal decoration, doing whatever secures a fine personal appearance, such as bathing, rubbing the body, perfuming it with cosmetics <ab>&c.</ab> .²2 [कर्त्रर्थे अण्] one who decorates or embellishes the person.
